evidence: At triage time on origin/main@05ea122083e6bc4cc0b9fd3e2c168e576e8f431c, the issue defined a published pack contract, third-party installation command, precision-gated defaults, and a public done-when, but no GH702 spec packet, PR, or implementation branch existed; this branch creates the first Draft packet.

The product and security choices are substantial enough to require product and technical specs before implementation.
GH702 can be specified independently of GH700 and GH701, while its public no-clone done-when remains coordinated with GH699.
